title: Student Attendance Record I
summary: Given a string s indicating a student's attendance with 'A' for absent, 'L' for late, and 'P' for present, determine if the student qualifies for an attendance award by being absent fewer than 2 times and never late for 3 consecutive days.
statement: Given a string s indicating a student's attendance with 'A' for absent, 'L' for late, and 'P' for present, determine if the student qualifies for an attendance award by being absent fewer than 2 times and never late for 3 consecutive days.
constraints: 1 <= len(s) <= 1,000; s contains only P, A, and L.
Accept only fewer than two total absences and no run of three late days.
hints: Count A and reset a late streak on non-L.
Scan characters; reject at the second A or third consecutive L.
The rules are local except for total absences. One pass maintains both counters.
editorial: The rules are local except for total absences. One pass maintains both counters.

tests.explanation: One absence and no late run reaches three, so it is eligible.
The final three L values are consecutive, so return false.
